records.idCN: 0资源道具/桦石
records.name: Chaos Stone
records.des: Crystals with a peculiar sheen, typically refined from glands inside Chaos Remains. Through special methods, Chaos Stones can be directly "generated" within Chaos world. Essentially, Chaos Stones are a type of material not shaped by morphic fields, allowing them to be molded into any material or produce energy using morphic field control tech. Many of the Chaos Stone's unique properties are still being researched. Transporting Chaos Stones requires special isolation boxes to prevent contamination from morphic fields.

records.idCN: 0资源道具/体力-澄明度
records.name: Clarity
records.des: During combat, allied crew members continually reduce their Clarity due to the sustained contamination from external morphic fields. Clarity gradually restores over time, but can also be quickly cleansed using items like Cactus Candy Roll.

records.idCN: 1抽卡道具/拉普拉斯协议
records.name: Laplace Protocol
records.des: <size=25><color=#FFB800>A necessary item for recruiting characters.</color></size>\nA communication protocol provided by Night Chains to its partners. Connected to the Night Chains' supercomputer located in an unknown location, it is able to precisely predict forthcoming crew members for the train.

records.idCN: 0资源道具/履历情报
records.name: Career Info
records.des:
Career Info provided by Night Chains, helps conductors further understand crew members.
[Carrer Info] is obtained when recruiting crews. <color=#FFB800>Each recruit grants 1 Career Info</color>.
Once you have obtained a total of <color=#FFB800>5</color> [Career Detail] to any character, any subsequent [Career Detail] obtained for that character will be automatically converted into [Career Info] at the following ratio:
Every <color=#FFB800>1</color> [Career Detail] of <color=#71CEFD>R</color> characters will be converted into <color=#FFB800>1</color> [Career Info].
Every <color=#FFB800>1</color> [Career Detail] of <color=#E4B7FF>SR</color> characters will be converted into <color=#FFB800>3</color> [Career Info].
Every <color=#FFB800>1</color> [Career Detail] of <color=#FFE266>SSR</color> characters will be converted into <color=#FFB800>10</color> [Career Info].
You can use [Career Info] to exchange for various items at the Night Chains Shop in the rest area in each city.

Director of the Metaphysical Particles Institute
Eliade

records.des:
<size=25><color=#FFB800>You may choose one passenger from the following SSR passenger list to board the train.</color></size>
Joshua, Katas, Suen, Nayuta, Charlotte, Verlaine, Connor, Stella, Caroline, Margiela, Wensheng, Ilona, Tennie, Ithos, Arina, Nicola, Dorothy, Dustin, Sommer, Shire.

Due to distrust of the Night Chains, Citadel developed its own version of the Laplace Protocol. It seems to have some influence on the future, which astonishes the personnel of the Night Chains.

records.idCN: 信物/2025巧克力·莉薇娅
records.name: 2025 Chocolate – Livia
records.des:
Holiday chocolate gifted by Livia, carefully handmade and presented in an exquisite box.
Enclosed is a letter sent with the chocolate.

Dear Conductor,

While I was out shopping this morning, I passed Carmine May and noticed a long line of young people. Upon asking, I learned that today holds special significance for the people of the Western Continent.
The queue was too lengthy, and I feared it would disrupt my schedule, so I didn't join the commotion...
However, after my return to the Eternal, Fran noticed my distracted demeanor. Well, she's always astute... So, I confessed that I hadn't bought the gift intended for you today, then she kindly offered to guide me in making one using the ingredients on the Eternal.

Well, that about sums it up. If you find it delicious, I'll whip up another one for you next year. You are the most special one in my life, Conductor.

records.idCN: 信物/2025巧克力·静流
records.name: 2025 Chocolate – Shizuru
records.des:
Holiday chocolate gifted by Shizuru, labeled as a 'holiday gift' from the BCRL Agency.
...But hey, has anyone else at the BCRL Agency mentioned receiving a gift like this?
Enclosed is a letter sent with the chocolate.

Conductor,
Once again, the BCRL Agency sent us holiday gifts, and I ended up with an extra batch. Karen is on a diet, Julian prefers bitter treats, and Dorothy got hers from Chief Heinrich. So, I'll just pass this on to you.
The flavor isn't half bad, it seems. Let me know your thoughts after giving it a try.

Shizuru

records.idCN: 信物/2025巧克力·亚莉奈
records.name: 2025 Chocolate – Arina
records.des:
Holiday chocolate gifted by Arina, handcrafted with care and a touch of sophistication.
Enclosed is a letter sent with the chocolate.

My Love,

Even though we see each other almost every day, special occasions deserve that extra touch of magic, don't they? I put some thought into this, hoping it brings you joy. And the ingredients in this chocolate? They're not your everyday fare, you know?
Being with you, dear conductor, fills me with pure bliss... These moments are the ones I cherish most. I wish they could last forever...

Will you join me at Viburnum tonight too? I'll be waiting for you with bated breath.

records.idCN: 信物/2025巧克力·妮蔻拉
records.name: 2025 Chocolate – Nicola
records.des:
Holiday chocolate gifted by Nicola. Who knows, maybe this will spark some genius ideas for you...?
Enclosed is a letter sent with the chocolate.

Conductor,

While I was working on a new product recently, the holiday season's arrival inspired me to enhance the chocolates in the current Anita rations. Before wrapping up the patent application, your name crossed my mind, so I decided to share a sample with you. Remember to provide feedback on the taste and, if possible, draft a tasting report.

Once you've finished your report, don't hesitate to bring it to me for review, and if writing isn't your strong suit... present yourself to me instead.

I could really use a special assistant during this holiday.

records.idCN: 信物/2025巧克力·乌刹娜
records.name: 2025 Chocolate – Ushana
records.des:
Holiday chocolate gifted by Ushana. No, it's not soap! It's chocolate... packed with that childlike creativity!
Enclosed is a letter sent with the chocolate.

Master Savior!

While I was helping my friends at Bonfire City, I heard that everyone shares chocolates on this special day. I totally remember seeing people sharing chocolates before!
So, I went up to the giant fish at the trading center and asked for some stuff to make this gift! I added mint, strawberries, watermelon, blueberries, apples... and loads and loads more! It turned out super colorful, bright, and oh-so cute!
 Time to dig in and munch away! Yum, yum!

Ushana

records.idCN: 信物/2025巧克力·那由他
records.name: 2025 Chocolate – Nayuta
records.des:
Holiday chocolate gifted by Nayuta. Today is actually his birthday.
Enclosed is a letter sent with the chocolate.

Dear Conductor,

The young scholars from the Citadel came to me with a promotional flyer from the dessert shop, wondering why chocolates were being sold in special bundles with lovely wrappings on my birthday.
It was in that moment that I discovered I share my birthday with such a unique event.
It's quite a rare occurrence when Mr. Dustin and Sommer aren't out on field operations, so we decided to treat ourselves to a chocolate cake.
I made sure to save a slice for you too. Wishing you joy on this special day.

Nayuta

records.idCN: 信物/2025巧克力·卡塔斯
records.name: 2025 Chocolate – Katas
records.des:
Holiday chocolate gifted by Katas. It's brimming with ultimate magic power! But seriously, are we sure this isn't some popular merchandise...?
O, Lord of Black Iron!

Rejoice! Rejoice! The time has come for the denizens of the earth to exalt and impart their love and gratitude. For this special occasion, I, the Cursed Sword Maiden, have meticulously crafted a keepsake just for you!
To create this keepsake, I journeyed far and wide, seeking counsel from the Erudite Sage of Yore, the Sanctified Wings of the Wind, and the Tailor of the Royal Court! After much deliberation, I imbued this keepsake with six potent blessings with my very own hands! To savor this divine artifact is to be graced with my benedictions...
Anyway... In short... you mustn't share this with others! Keep it all to yourself, got it?

Next time, I'll whip up something even more amazing for you! And don't forget to share your thoughts after tasting it!

Jumakenki

records.idCN: 信物/2025白情巧克力纪念·闻笙
records.name: 2025 White Valentine's Day Chocolate Commemoration · Wensheng
records.des:
Wensheng gifted a holiday chocolate. A simple yet sophisticated gift box, with powdered sugar scattered like the snow in Frostville City.
Attached was an email sent with the chocolate:

"An eye for an eye is my principle. To repay kindness with kindness as well.
Over the past year, you have taken great care of the colleagues at Night Chains. Mr. Sagi often mentions you and has expressed regret at not having had the chance to meet you, urging me to maintain close contact with you, and I believe he is right.
Therefore, on this day of expressing gratitude, I am sending you this gift.

I also hope you have more opportunities to collaborate with Night Chains in the future. Let's meet more often elsewhere."

records.idCN: 信物/2025白情巧克力纪念·达斯廷
records.name: 2025 White Valentine's Chocolate Commemoration · Dustin
records.des:
Festive chocolates gifted by Dustin. The packaging is indeed playful, but isn't it a bit too playful...
Attached is an email sent with the chocolates:

Earlier when meeting Nayuta, I heard him mention that you celebrated a birthday together. Thank you for your care for Nayuta and Sommer all this time. Hearing from the two children that you've been doing well recently puts my mind at ease.
The last opportunity I had to spend such a youthful holiday with someone was probably when Melanie was still alive... I was young then. I won't say much about the past, just hope you'll accept this gift.
Spring is coming, and you're welcome to visit the greenhouse to chat whenever you have free time.

records.idCN: 信物/2025白情巧克力纪念·西蒙
records.name: 2025 White Valentine's Chocolate Commemoration · Simon
records.des:
Simon gave a festive chocolate. Just looking at its appearance, you can tell it's expensive.
Attached is an email sent with the chocolate:

The day of reckoning has arrived—the day of the showdown between me and my only rival should, of course, be chosen to coincide with a festival.
How about it? Seeing this high-end chocolate that ordinary people won't have a chance to taste in their lifetime and requires a six-month advance reservation, you must already be convinced of my superiority, unable to hold back tears as you admit your defeat! You absolutely won't find a better chocolate than mine—this time, without a doubt, I win! Use this chocolate to soothe the bitterness of your defeat!

records.idCN: 信物/2025白情巧克力纪念·隼&飞鸟
records.name: 2025 White Valentine's Chocolate Commemoration · Hayabusa & Songbird
records.des:
Hayabusa (and Songbird) gifted holiday chocolates. Each chocolate is a random flavor—note, purely random. 
Attached is an email sent with the chocolates: 

Did seeing this sender's name make your heart race? Whether you see this gift as proof of love or a spontaneous prank, I hope you can accept it. 
You must be thinking now, "Well then, let's consider it love," right? But it's too early to be pleased, at least try the taste of the chocolate first. 
Additionally, a sad little bird in the wind asked me to convey this message—
(The message below is written in a different elegant handwriting)
This is a gift of gratitude. My brother enjoys pranks a bit too much and has caused you trouble; sorry about that.
Happy White Day... Can I say that? If there's a chance in the future, I also want to express this to you face-to-face :) 

Hayabusa & Songbird

records.idCN: 信物/2025白情巧克力纪念·莱卡吉亚
records.name: 2025 White Day Chocolate Commemoration·Lycagia
records.des:
Lycagia's gift of holiday chocolates. Although simple, the quality is reassuring.
Attached is an email sent with the chocolates:

Conductor:

What should I write here? I'm not quite sure.
I've been in Bonfire City for many years, but I generally don't have many people to spend this kind of holiday with... After all, the busier the city gets, the more hectic we members of the BCRL Agency become. But I happened to see these chocolates at the Supply area and kept hearing colleagues say that this is a day suitable for expressing gratitude and acceptance, so I bought them and sent them to you!
Besides, everyone keeps saying it's not good for me to eat chocolate...
Anyway, happy holidays! See you later!

Lycagia

records.idCN: 5制造书/制造工作台/精钢伐木斧工艺指南

records.idCN: 活动代币/林间呓语-树泪

records.des: 在那棵大树被称为瘴母之前，林场的人们经常收集她的眼泪——也就是树汁，并且把它应用在方方面面。工匠将它与草木灰结合，变成结实的树胶；妇人在漫长的冬夜将它用作灯油，几滴就能照亮一整夜……直到那场焚烧改变了一切。

莉薇娅赠送的节日巧克力。手工制作后精心挑选了包装盒，虽然与去年的看起来相似，但内含的心意更为丰富。
附上了一封随巧克力寄来的邮件：

亲爱的列车长，

去年约定要继续给你做今年的节日巧克力的时候，我也没想到这一年是过得如此之快……
伴随着在您身边度过的这些日子，我增进了对西大陆文化的了解，也知道了在这个节日中赠送礼物时代表的含义。既是为了遵守诺言，也是为了表达我的心情，我准备了这份礼物。

节日快乐，能与您一同度过这个节日，我非常开心。
致列车长。我最重要的人。

列车长，
是铁盟配发的物资……今年也这么说就有点瞒不过你了吧？不过，就当是这样吧。
在过去的一年中都没什么机会见面，不过能常常收到你的消息，对我来说也是种不错的感觉。就和还是同班同学、一起去玩闹的那些时间一样。
最近有空的话，我们约个时间一起出来走走吧。

静流。

records.idCN: 信物/2026巧克力·卡塔斯
records.name: 2026巧克力·卡塔斯
records.des:
卡塔斯赠送的节日巧克力。她似乎对自己和自己的厨艺更有信心了。
附上了一封随巧克力寄来的邮件：

黑铁之主啊！

欢庆吧！喜悦吧！此即为地上的人们散播爱恋与感谢之情的节日，值此，吾咒魔剑姬特为你准备了信物——
数百个日升月落已逝，吾之力量亦大为精进，制作此品已无需大肆烦扰相识友人。因而，此为吾独力制作的、重生之甜蜜飨宴！虽然外观看起来一样但味道肯定更好了！！
而且，谢谢你一直陪我玩和排练……对了我要去清扫咖啡厅厨房了，就说这么多先！
下次排练别迟到哦！等你！

咒魔剑姬 留

列车长，

和去年一样，给你也留了一块巧克力蛋糕。

节日快乐。

那由他。

附上了一封随巧克力寄来的邮件：
让我猜猜看，今年看到发信人和标题的时候，你是不是想着“不就是你们两兄妹的小把戏”之类的拆开包裹了？不过很可惜，今年没有飞鸟的份，这份巧克力是我“单独”送给你的。

至于那只小鸟儿飞去哪里了……
等时机合适的时候我再当面告诉你吧。

records.idCN: 1抽卡道具/自选协议S10
records.name: 安提基特拉协议S10
records.des:
<size=25><color=#FFB800>可以从以下SSR乘员名单中自选一名乘员搭乘列车。</color></size>
约书亚，卡塔斯，苏恩，那由他，夏洛蒂，薇尔岚，柯娜，星花，卡洛琳，马吉拉，闻笙，伊洛娜，苔妮，伊索斯，亚莉奈，妮蔻拉，多萝西，达斯廷，索玛，夏尔，安菲娅，丽桑德拉，雅莱，帕拉笛，隼，佩罗塔，罗洁尔·定格，罗洁尔，奥莉薇恩，莱卡吉亚，涟，真咲，瑞瓦，克洛伊，小麦，伊利亚德，海伦娜，切茜娅，时萝，陈书闲，沃斯托克，拉妲，露比，美琪。

出于对黑月的不信任，学会制作了自己版本的拉普拉斯协议。似乎能一定程度上对未来造成影响。黑月的人员对此感到不可思议。
